input.data_exporter_profile: EU Exporter GmbH — 欧盟制造业企业，客户关系管理数据
input.data_importer_profile: US Importer Inc. — 美国CRM服务商，受FISA 702管辖
input.third_country_assessment: 美国存在政府机构大规模访问风险(Schrems II)，FISA 702条款允许情报机构获取数据
input.supplementary_measures: 端到端加密(AES-256)、严格密钥管理(HSM)、访问透明报告、数据本地化备份
input.final_conclusion: 在补充措施(端到端加密+HSM密钥管理)有效实施的前提下，SCC可作为合法传输工具

coverage_note: This case exercises the UNSTRUCTURED compatibility path. risk_level remains the legacy keyword-derived LOW value, while the additive deterministic decision fails closed to suspend because the storage:// SCC is not locally verifiable and no country-law evidence is present. These fields have different meanings: LOW does not authorize a transfer. The 02_structured case separately covers the structured country-risk and measure-sufficiency engine.
